aggregation.name: aggregation
aggregation.description: A whole and the parts it gathers, which live on without it. The hollow diamond is at the whole, the from end.

association.name: association
association.description: Two definitions that know of each other: each end says how many, in what role, and whether it can be reached.

attribute.name: attribute
attribute.description: A field a definition asks of its usages, and the value each answers. A component: its definition is a type, an enum or an alias, in its package's library; never a card, a layer or an explorer row.

block.name: block
block.description: A part, a system, or the template of one: something with parts, data or deeper significance. What it holds is its layer.

class.name: class
class.description: A class diagram: what its types are — the definitions its references stand for, each a class card, fields then behaviours, joined by what they extend and the relations stored between them.

composition.name: composition
composition.description: A whole and the parts it owns: the parts go when the whole does. The filled diamond is at the whole, the from end.

constraint.name: constraint
constraint.description: A rule a block or a line is held to: the values it must answer, and on a line those its ends must agree on. A component: defined in its package's library and applied by id; advice, never a refusal.

decision.name: decision
decision.description: A flow's question: one way in, a line out for each answer, each line named by its answer.

dependency.name: dependency
dependency.description: One relies on another: a change to the supplier may change the client. Dashed, its head at the supplier.

end.name: end
end.description: Where a flow or a state machine finishes: lines in, none out.

entity.name: entity
entity.description: An entity relationship diagram: how its data is stored — the definitions its references stand for, each a schema card, columns and keys, joined by the relations stored between them, their ends drawn as multiplicities.

flow.name: flow
flow.description: A flow: what moves through a process — its steps and decisions, and the lines each passes on along, laid out by where they point. A block's behaviour.

folder.name: folder
folder.description: Organization: a box on its parent's layer, what it holds drawn inside. It never makes a layer; selected in the explorer, the canvas zooms to it.

grid.name: grid
grid.description: A spreadsheet of cells holding text or blocks, opened on the allocation view: a header allocates what its row or column holds.

group.name: group
group.description: A box drawn round its members, on the layer it sits on: its name tags them.

interface.name: interface
interface.description: A block's boundary, where relations and flows enter and leave: a port, data on any block that has ports, seated on its wall. A component: its definition is an interface definition in its package's library; never a card, a layer or an explorer row.

internal.name: internal
internal.description: A block diagram: what a block is made of — its parts and the relations between them.

label.name: label
label.description: One line of text and no card: free, or tied to what it names. Its name tags what it is tied to.

line.name: line
line.description: A relation between two blocks: what flows, connects or depends.

message.name: message
message.description: One participant asks another to act: a message between two steps.

note.name: note
note.description: A remark about what it is tied to: a markdown body. It holds nothing, and tags nothing.

reference.name: reference
reference.description: Stands for a block, a definition or a package elsewhere, drawn where it is needed without moving it.

region.name: region
region.description: A band across the layer, under its heading: what lies in it are its members, and its name tags them. Regions stack, and reorder by drag.

reply.name: reply
reply.description: An answer to a message, drawn dashed.

sequence.name: sequence
sequence.description: A sequence: who talks to whom, in what order — a grid read as time, the header row naming the participants and each row a moment, its lines the messages. A block's behaviour.

start.name: start
start.description: Where a flow or a state machine begins: one line out to its first step or state.

state.name: state
state.description: A state machine: how one thing changes — the states it is in, and the transitions between them, laid out by where they point. A block's behaviour.

swimlane.name: swimlane
swimlane.description: A swimlane: who does what, in which phase — a grid read as lanes, the header row naming the participants and the header column the phases, the steps in their cells. A block's behaviour.

tag.name: tag
tag.description: A word to find things by, and what it means. A component: defined in its package's library, carried by usages, lines and definitions; never a card, a layer or an explorer row.

tie.name: tie
tie.description: A relation with no model meaning: a dotted run with no heads, from a note or label to what it describes.

transition.name: transition
transition.description: A state machine's move from one state to the next: its name the event that fires it, with any guard and action.

treemap.name: treemap
treemap.description: A treemap: where the weight is — what it holds, each as large as what it holds in turn, in the boxes of its folders, groups and regions.
